`nist_ftc_08_asme1_ap242-e2.stp.gz` contains the unchanged STEP bytes from
[dw-examples](https://github.com/pzfreo/dw-examples/blob/2d0a33c706c70c539f62d8e20f648c73c598071d/steps/nist/nist_ftc_08_asme1_ap242-e2.stp).
The NIST MBE PMI Validation and Conformance Testing Project published this AP242
model as a U.S. federal government work. Its PMI and declared inches exercise
the released hole-table regression.
